lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A geometric matrix of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in near-vertical columns posterior to the gill region. Vertical columns contain between 4 and 6 discrete spots, with inter-spot distance decreasing toward the ventral margin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the high-luminance spot centroids, forming a regular grid-like lattice across the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and deep shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 3-4 visible high-luminance spots located within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, concentrated primarily in the lower-posterior region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent horizontal high-intensity linear mark (potential scar) is located on the upper anterior flank dorsal to the gill slits; a small, dark, elongated spindle-shaped object is visible attached ventrally near the posterior base of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a significantly higher spatial density and smaller average diameter of high-luminance spots compared to the ordered grid-like patterning on the lateral flank.
